page.notes: The word after "Sed" (printed with a stroke over the letters) is doubtful; read as ꝗa. The Greek words after "ratione" and the word "faciendis" (printed across a line end as facie-dis) are doubtful. The word "Intellectus" in the line "Intellectus enim" may be misprinted as "Intcllectus" and is copied as read. The Greek word "ποιητικὸς" is also uncertain in its accents.
